notes: Jolrael, Mwonvuli Recluse, printed: 'Whenever you draw your second card each turn, create a 2/2 green Cat creature token.' It counts the cards drawn in the whole turn, also those drawn before Jolrael was on the battlefield. In turn 1 I cast a Crash Through (my first card of the turn, Jolrael is still in my hand), then put Jolrael onto the battlefield, then cast a second Crash Through: my second card of the turn is drawn with Jolrael in play, and it makes one Cat.
